mechanism: Venlafaxine inhibits serotonin reuptake which may potentiate vasodilation effects of sacubitril's neprilysin inhibition, and both agents affect blood pressure and cardiac hemodynamics through different pathways.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and renal function closely; educate patient on orthostatic hypotension symptoms and ensure appropriate dosing of both agents with potential downward titration if hypotension develops.
